answer: Hop-style sybil-hunting bounties make every miner a detective. First, epoch rewards sit in a 14-day escrow. Second, anyone can post a 10 POA bond and file a report linking five or more accounts through shared funding wallets or matching submit times. Third, seven random veterans rule within 72 hours. Fourth, a confirmed cluster forfeits its escrow: 25% to the hunter, the rest burned. A 50-account farm earning 40 POA each risks 2,000 POA per epoch, and with hunters scanning the horizon, safe profit is a fable. Its odds hit their nadir, like a pickpocket in a crowd paid to watch his hands.
